title: Call Me by the Name I Chose
inspiredBy: MONTERO (Call Me by Your Name) (Lil Nas X, 2021)

lyrics:
[Intro: flamenco-style guitar run, handclaps, a low hum]
Mm-mm, mm-mm

[Verse 1: low, relaxed, half sung]
I was a good kid in a borrowed shirt
Said the right things so nobody got hurt
Kept the real one folded in a drawer
I'm not folding any more

[Pre-Chorus: 808 bass slides in, falsetto]
You can keep the one they gave me
It was never mine to wear

[Chorus: heavy bass, handclaps, hummed hook between lines]
Call me by the name I chose
Say it like you mean it, say it slow
I don't answer to the old one, no
Mm-mm, mm-mm
Call me when you're ready, call me bold
Call me by the name I chose

[Verse 2: low, playful, a grin in it]
Showed up to the party in my grandmother's ring
Somebody said "who's that?" and I said "everything"
I've been underlined, I've been crossed out too
Now I sign it how I want, in blue

[Pre-Chorus: 808 bass slides, falsetto]
You can keep the one they gave me
It was never mine to wear

[Chorus: heavy bass, handclaps, hummed hook between lines]
Call me by the name I chose
Say it like you mean it, say it slow
I don't answer to the old one, no
Mm-mm, mm-mm
Call me when you're ready, call me bold
Call me by the name I chose

[Bridge: guitar and claps only, spoken-sung, close]
To the kid in the borrowed shirt
I kept your drawer
There's nothing in it now

[Final Chorus: full, falsetto harmonies, guitar flourishes]
Call me by the name I chose
Say it like you mean it, say it slow
I don't answer to the old one, no
Mm-mm, mm-mm
Call me by the name I chose

[Outro: hum, a final guitar flourish, handclap]
Mm-mm
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 89 BPM with a double-time sway, G-sharp minor with a Spanish, Phrygian colour. Sultry, loose and confident.

VOICE: Male, low and relaxed in the verses, half sung with a smile, then a light, bright falsetto in the pre-chorus. A deep, wordless hum is the main hook and returns between chorus lines. Falsetto harmonies in the last chorus. Spoken-sung and close in the bridge.

INSTRUMENTS: A nylon-string guitar playing fast flamenco-style runs and strums. Flamenco handclaps in a syncopated pattern. A heavy, sliding 808 sub-bass. A sparse trap-style kick and snare with rattling hi-hats. A dark synth pad. A plucked string figure in the chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, a guitar run, handclaps and the hum. 0:11 Verse 1. 0:33 Pre-chorus. 0:44 Chorus 1. 1:06 Verse 2. 1:28 Pre-chorus. 1:39 Chorus 2. 2:01 Bridge, guitar and claps, three lines. 2:12 Final chorus, five lines with falsetto harmonies. 2:30 Outro, the hum, a guitar flourish and one clap at 2:38.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2020s pop-rap: guitar and claps dry and upfront, the bass enormous underneath, vocals close and lightly tuned.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The hummed hook over the guitar in the first five seconds.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The bridge speaks to the younger self directly and reports that the drawer is empty. The name could be chosen at twenty or at sixty, and the song is written to hold either.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Remembered hiding, play, pride, peace with the past.
